description_en: Changes the threshold of computing resources and the wait period of idle resources for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance in Serverless automatic scheduling mode
description_zh: 修改AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版Serverless自动调度模式实例的计算资源阈值和空闲释放等待时长
name: ModifyDBInstanceConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例当前所属的资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The threshold of computing resources. Valid values: 8 to 32. Unit: AnalyticDB Compute Units (ACUs)
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源阈值。取值范围为8~32，单位为ACU
parameters.name: serverless_resource

parameters.help_en: The wait period for the instance that has no traffic to become idle. Minimum value: 60. Default value: 600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 空闲释放等待时长。即当无业务流量的时长达到指定时长后，实例转为空闲状态。单位为秒，最小值为60，默认值为600
parameters.name: idle_time

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the operation fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，仅调用失败时返回

Status.description_en:
The state of the operation. Valid values:

0: The operation failed.
1: The operation is successful
Status.description_zh:
修改状态，返回信息如下：

0：修改失败。
1：修改成功
